questions.question: Use hide_dimensions with dimensions equal to Stress_Level_1_10, hide, mode equal to hide and use reorder_dimensions with dimension_order equal to AI_Tool_Usage_%, Hours_Coded, Code_Complexity_Score, Bugs_Introduced, Stress_Level_1_10 in order to know What patterns can you observe in the relationships between AI tool usage, coding hours, code complexity, bugs introduced, and stress levels among high burnout risk developers?

answer.value: Several key patterns emerge: 1) Higher AI tool usage correlates with more bugs introduced (0.623 vs 0.460), 2) Code complexity strongly correlates with bugs (r=0.592), 3) More coding hours correlate with higher stress levels (r=0.484), 4) Bugs introduced also correlate with stress (r=0.480). These patterns suggest complex interactions between work factors and burnout risk.

key_insights: AI tool usage correlates with more bugs introduced
Code complexity strongly correlates with bugs
Coding hours correlate with higher stress levels
Bugs introduced correlate with stress levels
Complex interactions exist between all work factors
